name: post-done-closure-snapshot-drift
title: Fix post-DONE closure snapshot material projection
description: For DONE stories, read-only closure/status diagnostics must report the historical DONE closure from the DONE snapshot instead of re-blocking the story against later current main material. Preserve strict current-material checks for TEST→DONE, but make post-DONE current-material revalidation explicit/advisory rather than the default blocking projection. Red repro: B-da34 is phase DONE yet done_closure reports canAttemptDone:false and stale delivery/review-escalation blockers after later main material drift.
